outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of flow cytometry dot/density plots where each point represents an individual cell event; there is no averaged/aggregated summary statistic (e.g., bar or line graph) that would require separate display of individual data points.
Panel B shows flow cytometry scatter plots of individual cell events (gating for PC), not an averaged summary statistic, so the individual-data-points requirement does not apply.
Panel C is a set of flow cytometry gating plots displaying individual cell events directly; it does not present averaged data requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay of flow cytometry dot plots (each dot is an individual cell), not a bar/mean plot of aggregated statistics, so this check does not apply.
Panel E shows flow cytometry gating scatter plots of individual cell events, not an averaged summary graph, so no additional individual data points display is required.
